name: Normal week
description: A representative clear/mixed week at Khavda with no unusual weather or load conditions. Baseline for comparing dispatch policies.

name: Monsoon stretch
description: HERO SCENARIO. A week containing at least two consecutive low-irradiance days (monsoon cloud cover), stressing the battery and diesel dispatch to protect critical (health-centre) load.

name: Lean season
description: Same weather window as S1 (Normal week), but with elevated diesel price and elevated load to model a lean-season / high-cost operating regime.
